title: Beyond Final Outcomes: Quantifying Claim-Level Information Dynamics in Multi-Agent LLM Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2610.32333v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When LLM-powered agents interact, information is repeatedly shared, expanded, and forgotten, yet multi-agent evaluation typically focuses on final task outcomes. We study such interaction as claim-level information dynamics and propose RIVER, which decomposes agent outputs into atomic claims and evaluates three complementary dimensions: convergence, exploration, and retention. Convergence captures cross-agent claim correspondence and stance alignment; exploration captures semantic breadth and extension beyond the source; and retention tracks source preservation and the persistence of new claims across stages and lineages. We evaluate five interaction strategies on 40 controlled news-generation cases. Repeatedly pooled interaction promotes convergence but narrows the information space, whereas distributed relay yields broader, less shared information. translated_title: 超越最终结果：量化多智能体LLM交互中的声明级信息动态
translated_abstract: 当基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体进行交互时，信息会被反复共享、扩展和遗忘，然而多智能体评估通常只关注最终任务结果。我们将这种交互作为声明级别的信息动态进行研究，并提出RIVER方法，该方法将智能体输出分解为原子声明，并评估三个互补维度：收敛性、探索性和保留性。收敛性刻画跨智能体的声明对应关系和立场一致性；探索性刻画语义广度以及超出源信息的扩展；保留性追踪源信息的保存情况以及新声明在各阶段和谱系中的持续性。我们在40个受控新闻生成案例上评估了五种交互策略。重复聚合式交互促进收敛但缩小了信息空间，而分布式接力式交互则产生更广泛、共享程度更低的信息。进一步比较表明，方法特定的约束能够增加探索性，而较弱的……
tldr: 本文提出RIVER框架，将多智能体LLM交互输出分解为原子声明，从收敛、探索和保留三个维度量化声明级信息动态，发现重复聚合式交互促进收敛但缩小信息空间，而分布式接力式交互能产生更广泛的信息。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RIVER, which decomposes multi-agent LLM interaction outputs into atomic claims to quantify claim-level information dynamics across convergence, exploration, and retention dimensions, finding that repeatedly pooled interaction promotes convergence but narrows the information space, while distributed relay yields broader, less shared information.
